subject: NovaHealth: Private Deployment — Implementation Playbook & Network Preflight
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novahealth.com>, Nora Singh <nora.singh@novahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaHealth: Private Deployment — Implementation Playbook & Network Preflight

Hi Samir / Nora,

Congrats again on the contract — excited to get NovaHealth onto Redwood Private. To make the first implementation sprint productive, attached is our lightweight install checklist and a short preflight questionnaire. Can you confirm the following by end of day Monday so our network team can begin the peering review?

- Primary cloud account/project IDs and the account owner (for VPC peering IAM).
- Expected egress IP ranges we should allow for private endpoints.
- Whether you will provide a transit/VPN or prefer our managed peering.
- Any HSM/KMS constraints (bring-your-own-key vs Redwood-managed).

High level plan we propose:
1) Network preflight & security Q (this week)
2) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) sign-off + scheduled handoff call
3) Staging deploy (on-prem package + private endpoints)
4) Cutover & runbook handover

Attachments: redwood_private_install_checklist.pdf, mutual_action_plan_v1.docx

Ping me any time — I’ll coordinate the CS handoff and weekly checkpoints. Ben and Laura are cc’d to start scheduling and scope the readiness call.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Nora Singh <nora.singh@novahealth.com>
Cc: IT Ops Team <it.ops@novahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth: Private Deployment — Implementation Playbook & Network Preflight

Monica — thanks, this looks good. A few clarifications from our side:

- Primary cloud account: aws-prod-nhs-01 (owner: Samir Patel). I’ll produce an IAM contact for peering.
- Egress: we prefer to restrict to a set of CIDR blocks; attaching our initial spreadsheet (novahealth_network_requirements.xlsx).
- Connectivity: we want to route via our transit gateway and will set up a VPC attachment on our side; would appreciate a short doc on Redwood’s peering expectations (eg BGP or static routes).
- KMS: we must BYOK for encryption at rest; need details on key formats and required rotations.

Also, can you call out any ports/protocols the on-prem appliance needs for customer-managed deployments? Our network team will need that for the change window request.

Samir
CTO, NovaHealth Systems

Attachment: novahealth_network_requirements.xlsx

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaHealth: Private Deployment — Implementation Playbook & Network Preflight

Thanks Samir — quick note on timeline and what we can own versus what we need from NovaHealth: 

- Timeline: if preflight completes this week, we can schedule staging deploy during the week of Apr 4. Production cutover target Apr 18 (flexible if your change window differs).
- Redwood provides the private endpoint and route guidance (we support both BGP and static). For transit gateway attachments, we will provide a short BGP config snippet and a set of required CIDRs.
- BYOK: Laura will loop in Security to verify key import and rotation cadence; there may be an EULA addendum for key custody.

Next steps: Laura and I will propose a 45-minute network preflight call — can you propose two 45-minute slots next week? We’ll bring infra + security.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth: Private Deployment — Implementation Playbook & Network Preflight

Samir / Nora — Laura here from Implementation. Per Ben’s note, attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that breaks the work into 2-week sprints and owner assignments. Key networking items we’ll cover on the call:

- VPC CIDR overlap check and peering prep
- Route propagation and BGP session parameters (ASN, timers, MD5 if needed)
- Private endpoint DNS flow and split-horizon recommendations
- On-prem appliance firewall rules and health-check ports (TCP 443, 10250, 50051 for telemetry; will provide full list)
- KMS import steps for BYOK + audit-log requirements

Please review the MAP and mark any owner changes directly in the doc. Proposed preflight call slots (PST):
- Tue Mar 23 10:00–10:45
- Tue Mar 23 15:00–15:45

If neither works, propose alternatives and we’ll accommodate. I’ll also upload a short BGP config snippet and the appliance port matrix to the SharePoint link in the related_links field.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.docx

---
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Nora Singh <nora.singh@novahealth.com>, IT Ops Team <it.ops@novahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth: Private Deployment — Implementation Playbook & Network Preflight

Thanks Laura — Tue Mar 23 15:00–15:45 works for our network lead (Ravi Kumar). I’ve attached a high-level network diagram and filled the spreadsheet with our CIDRs. A couple quick notes before the call:

- We run ASN 64512 on our transit; we prefer BGP with MD5.
- Our security team requires the BYOK import to be done during a maintenance window; we will coordinate once we see the import steps.
- Ravi will join the call and owns the firewall change request.

I’ll upload the detailed diagram to our Confluence shortly; for the call, please send the BGP snippet and the appliance port matrix beforehand so Ravi can review.

Regards,
Samir Patel
CTO, NovaHealth Systems

Attachment: novahealth_network_diagram_v1.png
